method.classifier: Shared title classifier from analyze_priority_repeats.py: Multi-purpose building, flood control, bridge and road.
method.attribution: Current legislative-district roster and strict qualified-location rules. Unique assignments only; shared and unresolved titles remain excluded from district totals.
method.timeLimit: Project locations are assigned to current legislative district boundaries. Representative labels are year-specific: explicit ODV term intervals for FY2020–FY2025 and the current 20th Congress roster for FY2026–FY2027. Ambiguous, missing, and default-only term records are left unresolved.
method.representativeSource: ODV static/data/congressmen_consolidated.json explicit term intervals; ODV static/data/20th_congress_representatives.json for FY2026–FY2027; source-linked, named exceptions are recorded in integrated-representative-photo-overrides.json. Broad default 2016–2025 terms are excluded.
method.sources: FY2016–FY2018 title-classified DPWH current-new-appropriation rows from the BetterGov GAA Explorer baseline; FY2020–FY2025 ODV annual GAA data; FY2026 DPWH Details Enrolled Copy; FY2027 House GAB 3rd-reading DPWH schedule. FY2016–FY2018 use a separate source layer; FY2027 is a proposal, not enacted GAA.

bulacanSignals: A large 2022–2023 increase in recorded project count and contract value, followed by a high 2024 level.
Bulacan became the largest single-province concentration in the 2022–2024 contract snapshot.
Several Bulacan municipalities repeatedly appear among the largest local totals.
reading.mpbConclusion: The cross-family district scan identifies Ilocos Norte 1st as a clear FY2022-to-FY2023 increase candidate: Flood control, multi-purpose buildings, roads, and bridges all rise in the integrated district totals. That resemblance is a pattern lead, not confirmation of a Bulacan-style mechanism; annual project classifications, attribution coverage, project scope and implementation context still need verification.
